request_input.query: Show a network of sponsors to drugs for Lung Cancer trials.

visualization.title: Sponsor-Drug Network for Lung Cancer Trials
visualization.subtitle: Network graph mapping lead sponsors to clinical interventions

meta.query_interpretation: This query requests a network visualization to show the relationships between different sponsors and the drugs they are developing or testing specifically for Lung Cancer trials. The goal is to identify which sponsors are associated with which drugs within this disease area.
notes: Aggregated 100 clinical trial records from ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.
Generated 36 deep source citations linking back to individual study NCT IDs.
